name: Writing Prompt Response
description: Responds to writing prompts with crafted creative pieces that honor the prompt's constraints while demonstrating narrative skill. Produces focused creative responses in any genre. Use when the user provides a writing prompt, creative prompt, story starter, or asks for a creative writing exercise response. Do NOT use for full short stories (use short-story-writing), flash fiction under 1,000 words with specific formal constraints (use flash-fiction), or poetry prompts (use poetry-writing).
